audience: gym owners and coaches who run a CrossFit or functional fitness gym on SugarWOD

useCases.title: Find the coaches and owners of the gym
useCases.text: List the gym's athletes filtered by role, and page through the list. Read the account owner of the gym's SugarWOD account.

useCases.title: Find an athlete by email
useCases.text: Find the athlete who registered with an email address. Open the profile to see the coach or owner flags and the last login.

useCases.title: See the workouts on a track this week
useCases.text: List the gym's tracks, then list the workouts of one track for a date range of up to 7 days. Open one workout for its movements.

useCases.title: Review who logged a score for a workout
useCases.text: List the athletes who logged a score for one workout, one page at a time. Open the workout to read its score type.

useCases.title: Correct an athlete's name or email
useCases.text: Change the first name, last name or email of one athlete. Only these three fields can be changed through the API.
